div.div:
نَدِىْءٌ , a subst., like طَبِيخٌ, [or rather an epithet in which the quality of a substantive predominates,] Flesh-meat, or bread, cooked, or baked, by being buried in hot ashes. (IAth, S.) لَحْمٌ نَدِىْءٌ Flesh-meat cooked, or baked, &c. (TA.) ―
-b2- [See also نَدْأَةٌ, in two places.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
